paras: Alopoglossus lehmanni is a species of lizard in the family Alopoglossidae. The species is endemic to Colombia.
The specific name, lehmanni, is in honor of Colombian biologist Federico Carlos Lehmann-Valencia.
A. lehmanni is found in western Colombia, in Valle del Cauca Department.
The natural habitat of A. lehmanni is forest. The holotype was collected at an elevation of 30 m (98 ft).
